title: General multidimensional CompOSE reader/writer: read all T x Yq x nb cells, arbitrary Nadd

phases.phase_1: DONE 2026-11-13. D1 data model (q_full(nT,nYq,7,n), q_extra_full(nadd_max,nT,nYq,n), nadd_max) + D3 select_slice. 12 tests PASS.
phases.phase_2: DONE 2026-11-13. D2 Step 1 (Nadd relaxation): reader accepts any Nadd>=0, stores every extra column in q_extra_full. 4 tests PASS.
phases.phase_3: DONE 2026-11-13. D2 Step 2 (multi-point Yq): nYq>1 cold slice reads into q_full(1,nYq,7,n). 9 tests PASS.
phases.phase_4: DONE 2026-11-14. D2 Step 3 (multi-point T): reader accepts nT>1, stores every (T,Yq,density) row in q_full(nT,nYq,7,n). The cold-slice path (nT==1, T=0) is unchanged. 4 new tests in test_e390_10b_multi_t.py PASS: 3T x 2Yq reads into q_full(3,2,7,n); select_slice materializes each (iT,iYq); 3T x 2Yq x n Nadd=1 round-trips q_extra_full; cold slice regression unaffected.
phases.phase_5: DONE 2026-11-14. D4 writer extension: write_internal_csv and write_internal_directory emit it_local/iy_local columns for nT>1/nYq>1, pulling Q1..Q7 and q_extra from the tensors per (T,Yq) block. read_internal_csv and from_internal_directory reconstruct q_full/q_extra_full from the it_local+iy_local rows. Lossless round-trip verified bit-for-bit in 4 tests: 3T x 2Yq x n Nadd=1; 3T x 1Yq x n Nadd=0 (multidim T only); 1T x 3Yq x n Nadd=2 (multidim Yq only); cold slice (no tensor).
phases.phase_6: DONE 2026-11-14. The 2 rejection tests in test_m10_generic_axes.py (test_multi_point_T_axis_is_rejected, test_nonzero_T_slice_is_rejected) are rewritten as acceptance tests (test_multi_point_T_axis_is_accepted_phase4, test_nonzero_T_slice_is_accepted_phase4). The 2 real-data slice-check tests (RG_SLY4, RG_KDE0v1) remain passing (already unblocked by E390-00).

outputs.2D/3D axes and cell-index parser: DELIVERED: read_compose accepts nT>=1 and nYq>=1; every (T,Yq,density) thermo row stores into q_full(nT,nYq,7,n); seen_3d(nT,nYq,n) coverage map for nT>1.
outputs.arbitrary Nadd (Nadd>=0) species/group/o: DELIVERED (phase 2): q_extra_full(nadd_max,nT,nYq,n) holds every extra column.
outputs.lossless round-trip test corpus for 2D/3: DELIVERED: 4 round-trip tests (3T x 2Yq, 3T x 1Yq, 1T x 3Yq, cold slice) all bit-for-bit.
outputs.3D tensor data model extension: DELIVERED: q_full(nT,nYq,7,n) and q_extra_full(nadd_max,nT,nYq,n) materialize for nT>1 or nYq>1; the cold-slice path (nT==1, nYq==1) leaves the tensors empty and uses the 1D q(7,n) surface, so M3-M6 downstream code is unaffected.

physics_contract.cold_slice: nT==1 AND T=0: unchanged path, 1D q(7,n) surface, no tensor
physics_contract.multidim_T: nT>1: q_full(nT,nYq,7,n) stores every (T,Yq,density) cell; 1D surface materializes (iT=1,iYq=1)
physics_contract.multidim_Yq: nYq>1: q_full(nT,nYq,7,n) stores every (Yq,density) cell (cold slice nT==1)
physics_contract.multidim_both: nT>1 AND nYq>1: full 3D tensor, every (T,Yq,density) cell
physics_contract.Nadd: any Nadd>=0 accepted; q_extra_full(nadd_max,nT,nYq,n) holds every extra column
physics_contract.index_convention: cold slice: 0-based or 1-based T declaration resolved by value; multidim: declared first index is the label origin, consecutive labels

non_claims: This extends the I/O layer to read/write multidim CompOSE tables; it does not construct new physics or run M3-M6 solvers on multidim tables.
The compo (eos.compo) reader still resolves a single selected (T,Yq) slice for the 1D composition arrays; multidim compo tensor storage is out of scope.
No new real-data multidim tables are added; the tests use synthetic 3T x 2Yq tables with distinct Q1 signatures per cell.

publication.frontend: Python eos_data.py (from_internal_directory, write_internal_directory) materializes the tensors
